feed.title: Taheri Lab
feed.subtitle: A computational biology lab developing machine learning methods to study cancer biology, predict drug interactions, and identify opportunities for drug repurposing.

entry.title: Swedish Research Council Starting Grant
entry.content:
Golnaz Taheri has been awarded a Starting Grant from the Swedish Research Council to develop graph-based machine learning methods for studying recurrence in advanced ovarian cancer.

The project will integrate biological knowledge with single-cell multi-omics data to identify molecular patterns associated with recurrence.
